phases.name: guideline single source and drift gate
documentation automation
phases.command: php artisan wiki:audit && test -f wiki/_meta/audit.json && test -f .claude/commands/document.md

phases.name: documentation
phases.command: rg -q 'Agent and AI-native' FEATURES.md && test -f .ai/rules/docs.md && rg -q 'wiki' README.md

phases.name: LSP plugins enabled with binaries on PATH
phases.command: command -v intelephense && command -v typescript-language-server && rg -q "php-lsp@claude-plugins-official" .claude/settings.json && rg -q "typescript-lsp@claude-plugins-official" .claude/settings.json

phases.name: guard-gates asks before an agent edits a mutation patch
each worktree gets its own database
phases.command: test -x bin/worktree-setup && rg -q worktree-setup .githooks/post-checkout && rg -q testing_ tests/bootstrap.php

phases.name: shared list URLs are a fixed point
a fresh clone resolves every slash command and subagent the agent kit names
workflow skills start without being named
a session's second app file is refused until a contract is frozen
the commit gate is fast and scoped to what is staged
the push gate skips a tree it already verified
the PR auditor workflow is built and off by default
hook, CI and switch-on steps are documented
phases.command: php artisan wiki:lint && rg -q 'Switching CI on' wiki/decisions/ci-quality.md
